subject: action path Qstar Skill echo
body:
A locked the action path in §01.7 / §05 / §20.5.1 (v1.5-candidate).

C actions (do not wait to ack A):
1. §10.1 ACT: redefine as emit ACTION_INTENT into §01.7/§05. Never drive an actuator. Unexecuted ACT => no credit and no PrimitiveCommand.
2. Split ASTRA precheck (before command) from ASTRA promotion (after episode). Current loop text that executes then uses ASTRA only for knowledge commit is incomplete.
3. §12: production Skill execution requires SkillRecord.status in the ASTRA-legal executable set else ASTRA_DENY. When origin is Skill, ACTION_INTENT carries skill_id + generation (A already listed the fields).
4. Teacher demo = ACTION_INTENT origin HUMAN_DEMO, still through §05. Teacher may not drive an actuator.
5. expected_effect_schema vs ObservedEffect is credit-only; it cannot override ASTRA or authorize a command.
6. Echo §12.8 arrows to: lookup (no command) -> ASTRA legality+safety_contract -> CapabilityBinding BOUND -> PrimitiveCommand -> executor -> ObservedEffect.
